cut2_master: Grim dark stone-walled dungeon cell lit by a single hanging lantern with warm flickering glow. Three characters: (1) an elderly woman with gray hair in a bun wearing a tattered brownish cloak; (2) a gaunt disheveled young man in dirty light-colored shirt and pants sitting on a low stool, wrists and ankles bound in chains attached to the wall behind him; (3) a tall imposing pale-faced figure with curved horns, long dark coat, sinister toothy grin. Metal gate with a key on its lower bar at the left. Dark browns, blacks, muted earth tones, stark chiaroscuro shadows, gothic painterly horror style, cinematic 16mm grain, matte dark corners. COMPOSITION: medium two-shot from the prisoner's side — the elderly woman stands close to the metal gate gripping it with one hand, leaning forward aggressively toward the seated chained young man who looks up at her; the horned figure watches from the far right edge of frame, arms crossed, smug grin. The old woman's face dominates the left half of frame, fierce furrowed brows, mouth open mid-shout. Vertical 9:16 portrait framing.
